name: Alias Manager
description: Adds a collapsible list of an entity's URL aliases to its edit form.
project_description: Alias Manager adds an extra section (a collapsible 'Alias manager' details element in the advanced/vertical-tabs group) to the edit form of any content entity whose entity type declares a 'canonical' link template. That section lists every URL path alias that points at the entity, with its language, and — for users who can create URL aliases — edit/delete operation links back to core's path admin routes. It relies entirely on core's path_alias storage; it defines no entities, routes, services, or config of its own. A similar but node-only module is 'Show node aliases'.
